create_field.description: Add a field to a table. Formula, lookup and multiple-choice fields need more setup; create those in Quickbase.
create_field.name: create_field

parameters.description: The table. Pick one, or give its id from an earlier step.
parameters.name: table_id

parameters.description: The field's name.
parameters.name: label

parameters.description: What the field holds. Defaults to text.
parameters.name: field_type

parameters.description: Hint shown beside the field on forms.
parameters.name: help_text

parameters.description: Whether every record must have a value for this field.
parameters.name: required

parameters.description: Whether no two records may share a value for this field.
parameters.name: unique

fieldHelp.description: The help text shown on forms

fieldType.description: The field's type, such as text or numeric

mode.description: Empty for a normal field, else formula, lookup or summary

required.description: Whether every record must have a value

create_record.description: Add a record to a table. Quickbase fills in the Record ID#, dates and owner itself.
create_record.name: create_record

parameters.description: The table. Pick one, or give its id from an earlier step.

parameters.description: The values to save, one per field. Fields you leave empty are not touched.
parameters.name: data

record.description: The record as saved: record_id and field labels

create_table.description: Add a table to an app. It starts with Quickbase's built-in fields; add more with 'Create field'.

parameters.description: Another app to use: the letters and digits after /db/ in its address, such as bqx3abc12. Leave empty for the app this connection was made with.
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.description: The table's name.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: What the table is for.
parameters.name: description

parameters.description: What one record is called, such as Customer. Defaults to Record.
parameters.name: single_record_name

parameters.description: What several are called, such as Customers. Defaults to Records.
parameters.name: plural_record_name

keyFieldId.description: The id of the table's key field

nextFieldId.description: The id the next field will get

nextRecordId.description: The Record ID# the next record will get

query_records.description: Find records in a table, by condition and in the order you choose. Returns one page; pass 'next_skip' as 'Skip' for more.
query_records.name: query_records

parameters.description: The table. Pick one, or give its id from an earlier step.
parameters.name: table_id

parameters.description: Which records, in Quickbase's query format: {field id.operator.value}, for example {6.CT.'Acme'} for field 6 containing Acme, or {6.EX.'Acme'}AND{7.GT.100}. Leave empty to match every record.
parameters.name: where

parameters.description: Leave empty to return every field.
parameters.name: select

parameters.description: The field to sort on. Without one, Quickbase's order.
parameters.name: sort_field

parameters.description: Which way to sort. Defaults to ascending.
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.description: How many records to return, 1 to 1000. Defaults to 100.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many records to skip, to get a later page. Use 'next_skip' from the page before.
parameters.name: skip

count.description: How many records are on this page

has_more.description: True if more records match after this page

next_skip.description: The 'Skip' that gets the next page, empty on the last

records.description: The records, each with record_id and one key per field label

items.description: One record: record_id and one key per field label

total_records.description: How many records match in all
